subtitle: From copper plates to code points, a script walks back into history

panels.shot: epic split-screen wide, left half showing a weathered copper plate in low temple light, right half a glowing computer screen of Meitei Mayek, with The Meitei Script Revival Scholar standing between, half in shadow, half in modern light
panels.action: The Meitei Script Revival Scholar stands at the junction of past and present, one hand gently over an ancient copper plate on a wooden table, the other touching a laptop where Meitei Mayek letters shine in a dimly lit study in Imphal.

dialogue.text: From the copper plates of old Kangleipak to Unicode and law, the body-named letters of Meitei Mayek fall, fade and rise again, carrying a people’s memory across fourteen centuries.

i18n.hi: पुराने कंगलेइपाक की ताम्रपट्ट से लेकर यूनिकोड और क़ानून तक, मैतेई मयेक के देह-नाम अक्षर चौदह सदियों से गिरते, मुरझाते, फिर उठ खड़े होते हैं, एक जाति की स्मृति ढोते हुए।

panels.shot: tight overhead on an engraved copper plate, lit by a shaft of light, with faint hands of a modern researcher just out of frame
panels.action: A close view of an ancient Yumbanlol copper plate lies on a museum mount, its Meitei Mayek letters finely incised, as dust motes drift through a single beam of light in a quiet archive room.

dialogue.text: On a copper plate dug from Manipur’s soil, letters lean like tiny spears of time, proving that by the late first millennium, Meitei Mayek already carried royal orders and land grants.

i18n.hi: मणिपुर की मिट्टी से निकली ताम्रपट्ट पर, अक्षर समय की नुकीली भालों जैसे झुके हैं, साबित करते हुए कि प्रथम सहस्राब्दी के अंत तक मैतेई मयेक में शाही फ़रमान और ज़मीन के दान लिखे जा चुके थे।

panels.shot: wide, time-lapse style composition showing early Manipur valley with hills, a small settlement, and overlaid ghostly lines of script floating above
panels.action: A sweeping view of the Manipur valley in an early age, wooden houses on stilts near a stream and hills beyond, while faint translucent Meitei Mayek letters drift above the landscape like a subtle aura.

dialogue.text: In ancient Kangleipak, where hills ring Loktak’s waters, the Meitei court formed, and its scribes carved their tongue into copper, stone and coin, naming each letter after the human body.

i18n.hi: प्राचीन कंगलेइपाक में, जहाँ पहाड़ लोकटक की झील को घेरे हैं, मैतेई दरबार जड़ें जमाता है, लिपिक तांबे, पत्थर और सिक्कों पर अपनी ज़बान उकेरते हैं, हर अक्षर को देह के अंग के नाम से पुकारते हुए।

panels.shot: medium close-up of a traditional scribe seated on the floor, carving into a copper plate, side light catching his focused face
panels.action: An early Meitei scribe sits cross-legged on a reed mat, carefully incising characters onto a Khongtekcha copper plate with a stylus, his brow furrowed in concentration inside a wooden hall.

dialogue.text: Each sign was a limb, an eye, a breast, a heart; Meitei Mayek was remembered as the script of the body, tying the act of writing to flesh, gesture and breath.

i18n.hi: हर चिन्ह कोई हाथ, आँख, वक्ष, या दिल था; मैतेई मयेक को देह की लिपि कहकर याद रखा गया, जहाँ लेखन का काम देह, इशारे और साँस से बँध जाता था।

panels.shot: low-angle interior of a modest shrine or hall at Khoibu, with a stone inscription panel set in a wall, villagers faintly visible bringing offerings
panels.action: Inside a small village shrine at Khoibu, a stone slab with worn Meitei Mayek carvings stands set into the wall, while villagers place flowers and baskets nearby in soft, flickering lamp light.

dialogue.text: At Khoibu, stone bore the script in a village shrine; in Yumbanlol and Khongtekcha, copper carried it, tying sacred, royal and local worlds with the same strokes.

i18n.hi: खोइबु के गाँव मंदिर की पत्थर दीवारों पर लिपि उकेरी गई; युंबनलोल और खोँगतेकचा के ताम्रपट्ट पर वही अक्षर खिंचे, एक ही रेखा से देव, राजा और गाँव की दुनिया को बाँधते हुए।

panels.shot: graphic montage: coins tumbling in the air, inscriptions superimposed, then fading into blankness toward the right edge
panels.action: A cascade of ancient Manipuri coins marked with Meitei Mayek glyphs falls through the dark, their details sharp on one side of the frame and fading into blurred emptiness toward the other side.

dialogue.text: Yet beyond a few plates, stones and coins, the trail thins; the surviving evidence is scattered, and scholars piece the history of Meitei Mayek like a broken necklace of clues.

i18n.hi: पर कुछ ताम्रपट्ट, पत्थरों और सिक्कों के आगे निशान धुँधला पड़ जाता है; जो साक्ष्य बचा, वह बिखरा है, और विद्वान मैतेई मयेक की कथा को टूटी माला के मोतियों की तरह जोड़ते हैं।

panels.shot: transition wide shot of Kangla fort in later medieval period, banners fluttering, with distant hill outlines
panels.action: Kangla fort rises in the center of the Manipur valley, its earthen ramparts and wooden halls busy with courtiers and soldiers, banners snapping in the wind against a pale sky.

dialogue.text: Centuries turned; Manipur’s kings ruled from Kangla, warred with neighbors and watched the world change, while Meitei Mayek remained the script of chronicles, ritual texts and state memory.

i18n.hi: सदियाँ बदलीं; मणिपुर के राजा कंगला से राज चलाते, पड़ोसियों से लड़ते और बदलती दुनिया देखते रहे, और मैतेई मयेक राज-इतिहास, अनुष्ठान ग्रंथों और राज्य-स्मृति की लिपि बना रहा।

panels.shot: dramatic interior of a royal hall, with Pamheiba on a raised seat, Vaishnavite priests and a Bengali scribe presenting a palm-leaf manuscript
panels.action: Inside a royal hall, King Pamheiba sits on a raised seat, flanked by Vaishnavite priests, as a Bengali scribe respectfully offers a palm-leaf manuscript written in Bengali script before him.

dialogue.text: In the eighteenth century, under King Pamheiba, Vaishnavism became court faith, and Bengali script rose in prestige, entering the palace with the new religious texts and teachers.

i18n.hi: अठारहवीं सदी में, राजा पामहेइबा के समय, वैष्णव धर्म दरबार की आस्था बना, और बांग्ला लिपि नई धार्मिक पुस्तकों और गुरुओं के साथ महल में दाख़िल होकर प्रतिष्ठित हो उठी।

panels.shot: split composition: on the left, a Meitei scribe with traditional manuscripts; on the right, a younger clerk copying into Bengali script
panels.action: On one side of a wooden table, an older Meitei scribe sits with Meitei Mayek manuscripts at his elbow; opposite him, a younger clerk carefully copies text into Bengali script, stacks of new palm-leaf bundles beside him.

dialogue.text: Bengali letters began to displace Meitei Mayek in court and ritual. Some traditions speak of burning old texts, but the record is contested; what is clear is that the older script lost ground and status.

i18n.hi: बांग्ला अक्षर दरबार और रीत-रिवाजों में मैतेई मयेक को हटाने लगे। कुछ परंपराएँ पुराने ग्रंथों के जलाए जाने की बात कहती हैं, पर प्रमाण विवादित हैं; जो साफ़ है, वह यह कि पुरानी लिपि ज़मीन और मान दोनों खो बैठी।

panels.shot: wide shot of a later 19th–20th century classroom in Manipur, blackboard with Bengali script, children seated on mats
panels.action: In a colonial-era schoolroom, Manipuri children sit on mats as a teacher writes Bengali letters on a blackboard, sunlight cutting through open windows onto battered wooden benches.

dialogue.text: By the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, Meitei literature flowed largely in Bengali script; schoolchildren learned to spell their mother tongue with foreign letters, while the body-named signs receded from daily sight.

i18n.hi: उन्नीसवीं और बीसवीं सदी की शुरुआत तक, ज़्यादातर मैतेई साहित्य बांग्ला लिपि में बहने लगा; स्कूल के बच्चे अपनी ही ज़बान विदेशी अक्षरों में सीखते रहे, जबकि देह-नाम चिन्ह रोज़मर्रा की आँखों से ओझल होते गए।

panels.shot: intimate medium shot in a modest house at Phayeng or Khoibu, with an elder handing a fragile manuscript to a young Meitei Script Revival Scholar
panels.action: In a simple wooden house, an elderly villager carefully passes a brittle palm-leaf manuscript to The Meitei Script Revival Scholar, who receives it with both hands, eyes wide with reverence.

dialogue.text: Yet in villages like Phayeng and Khoibu, some manuscripts, inscriptions and memories survived. In the twentieth century, scholars and elders began to bring these out, letter by letter, story by story.

i18n.hi: फिर भी फायेँग और खोइबु जैसे गाँवों में कुछ पांडुलिपियाँ, शिलालेख और यादें बची रहीं। बीसवीं सदी में विद्वान और बुज़ुर्ग इन्हें फिर बाहर लाने लगे—अक्षर दर अक्षर, कहानी दर कहानी।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close-up of the scholar’s notebook, where each Meitei Mayek letter is sketched with a body-part label
panels.action: Seen from over the shoulder, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar’s notebook shows careful sketches of Meitei Mayek letters, beside each a handwritten note naming the body part it recalls.

dialogue.text: Researchers traced old descriptions and oral teachings: letters as eyelid, tooth, spine. The script’s design, they argued, encoded a human figure, making literacy an almost physical memory.

i18n.hi: शोधकर्ताओं ने पुराने वर्णन और मौखिक शिक्षाएँ टटोलीं: अक्षर पलक, दाँत, रीढ़ की हड्डी। उनका कहना था कि लिपि की बनावट में पूरा मानव शरीर छिपा है, जिससे साक्षरता मानो देह की स्मृति बन जाती है।

panels.shot: medium shot in a university seminar room, with the scholar presenting slides of early inscriptions to a small audience
panels.action: Inside a small seminar room, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar points to projected images of the Yumbanlol and Khoibu inscriptions, a few students and fellow researchers listening intently in the dim light.

dialogue.speaker: the_meitei_scholars_of_the_script_revival
dialogue.text: These stones and plates show our script lived long before its supposed ‘invention’.

i18n.hi: ये पत्थर और ताम्रपट्ट दिखाते हैं कि हमारी लिपि उसकी कथित ‘खोज’ से बहुत पहले जीती-जागती थी।

panels.shot: tight shot on the scholar reading Sahitya Akademi publications, with stacks of reference books around
panels.action: Surrounded by stacks of Sahitya Akademi volumes and reports by K.S. Singh and Mahoharan, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar reads, underlining passages and placing notes between the pages.

dialogue.text: National surveys and Sahitya Akademi studies placed Meitei Mayek among the Brahmi-derived scripts of eastern India, anchoring revival not in nostalgia alone, but in epigraphic and linguistic evidence.

i18n.hi: राष्ट्रीय सर्वेक्षणों और साहित्य अकादमी के अध्ययनों ने मैतेई मयेक को पूर्वी भारत की ब्राह्मी-परंपरा की लिपियों में रखा, जिससे पुनर्जीवन केवल नॉस्टैल्जिया नहीं, बल्कि अभिलेखीय और भाषाई प्रमाण पर टिका।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of the scholar addressing a public meeting in Imphal, bannerless stage, with people of different ages in the audience
panels.action: On a bare stage in Imphal, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar speaks to a gathered crowd of elders, youths and schoolchildren, their faces a mix of curiosity and resolve.

dialogue.speaker: the_meitei_scholars_of_the_script_revival
dialogue.text: A script is not just letters. It is how our ancestors touched sound.

i18n.hi: लिपि सिर्फ़ अक्षर नहीं होती; यह वह तरीका है, जिससे हमारे पूर्वजों ने ध्वनि को छुआ।

panels.shot: close-up of a computer screen showing a Unicode proposal document, with Meitei Mayek glyph charts; scholar’s hand pointing
panels.action: A glowing computer screen displays a Unicode proposal featuring a chart of Meitei Mayek glyphs and code points, as The Meitei Script Revival Scholar’s finger traces down the list.

dialogue.text: The struggle moved into a new arena. In the 2000s, activists and linguists pushed Meitei Mayek into Unicode, arguing line by line until, in 2009, its block entered the global standard.

i18n.hi: संघर्ष अब नए मैदान में पहुँचा। 2000 के दशक में कार्यकर्ता और भाषाविद मैतेई मयेक को यूनिकोड में धकेलते रहे, पंक्ति दर पंक्ति दलील देते, जब तक कि 2009 में इसका ब्लॉक वैश्विक मानक में दर्ज न हो गया।

panels.shot: wide modern newsroom shot with Meitei-language newspapers being laid out on computers, Meitei Mayek on the screens and proofs
panels.action: In a lively newsroom, layout artists sit before computers where Meitei Mayek headlines shine, while printed proofs with the same bold letters are spread across a long desk.

dialogue.text: Once encoded, the letters flowed into fonts and printing presses. Newspapers and magazines began to appear in Meitei Mayek, letting valley and hill readers see their speech in its older form again.

i18n.hi: एक बार कोडिंग होते ही अक्षर फ़ॉन्ट और छापेखानों में बह निकले। अख़बार और पत्रिकाएँ मैतेई मयेक में छपने लगीं, घाटी और पहाड़ दोनों जगह पाठक अपनी बोली को फिर पुरानी शक्ल में देख पाने लगे।

panels.shot: solemn medium shot inside the Manipur Legislative Assembly, with the scholar watching from the gallery as legislators sit below
panels.action: From the visitors’ gallery of the Manipur Legislative Assembly, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar watches legislators in session, files and microphones laid out on their desks.

dialogue.text: In 2021, the Manipur Official Language Amendment Act recognized Meitei Mayek alongside Bengali script, making the revived letters part of official administration and education once more.

i18n.hi: 2021 में मणिपुर ऑफ़िशियल लैंग्वेज अमेंडमेंट एक्ट ने मैतेई मयेक को बांग्ला लिपि के साथ मान्यता दी, और पुनर्जीवित अक्षरों को फिर से सरकारी प्रशासन और शिक्षा का हिस्सा बना दिया।

panels.shot: intimate classroom shot of a young girl tracing Meitei Mayek on a slate, the scholar watching from the doorway
panels.action: In a bright village classroom, a young girl carefully traces Meitei Mayek characters on a slate, while The Meitei Script Revival Scholar stands at the doorway, watching with a quiet, hopeful smile.

dialogue.text: Once, children learned their tongue in borrowed letters; now they trace the body-script their ancestors named, closing a gap of centuries with each line carved into slate.

i18n.hi: कभी बच्चे उधार लिए अक्षरों में अपनी ज़बान सीखते थे; अब वे वही देह-लिपि साधते हैं, जिसे उनके पूर्वजों ने नाम दिया था, हर स्लेट पर खिंची रेखा से सदियों की खाई पाटते हुए।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot by Loktak Lake at dusk, scholar holding a sheet with Meitei Mayek letters, hills and water behind
panels.action: At dusk beside Loktak Lake, The Meitei Script Revival Scholar stands holding a sheet filled with Meitei Mayek letters, the calm water and darkening hills reflecting the fading light.

dialogue.text: Meitei Mayek’s path—from copper plate to near eclipse to law, print and code—shows how a script can be pressed down yet not erased, carrying a people’s layered past into every future line they write.

i18n.hi: मैतेई मयेक की राह—ताम्रपट्ट से लगभग गुमनामी, फिर क़ानून, छपाई और कोड तक—दिखाती है कि कोई लिपि दब तो सकती है, मिटती नहीं, और हर अगली लिखी पंक्ति में एक कौम का तह-दर-तह अतीत उठाए चलती है।

title_i18n.en: Meitei Mayek: Letters of the Body

subtitle_i18n.en: From copper plates to code points, a script walks back into history
subtitle_i18n.hi: तांबे की तख़्ती से कोड पॉइंट तक, लिपि फिर इतिहास में लौटती है
